item.text: The lifecycle table is in `config/os.go`; Ubuntu 20.04 currently has only its standard support date, and 22.04 is absent. Gost’s Ubuntu release allowlist also excludes 22.04, which would prevent CVE lookup even after lifecycle detection succeeds, so I’m updating both lists and their existing tests.
